audit: Authority Swap Part 2c independent fact-overlap and source-concentration audit
scope: Read-only audit of the Part 2b source-reviewed originals. No model experiments, new literature, source-page browsing, or fresh verification performed. All replacement questions remain subject to independent fresh source/key checks.
input_files: outputs/Authority Swap - Part 2b Source and Key Ledger.csv

atom_policy.unit: A proposition about an entity and one property, using stable semantic IDs. Numeric table cells for every compared candidate are separate atoms; identities include relevant alternative properties when source-derived exclusion needs them.
atom_policy.stem_facts: Facts supplied in stems count as exposure and are included even for excluded arithmetic questions.
atom_policy.shared_page: Sharing a page or entity is allowed when tested properties differ; shared pages alone are not factual overlap.
atom_policy.excerpt_boundary: The full excerpt is retained as evidence, but unrelated clauses in an excerpt are not automatically treated as question atoms. This prevents broad source passages from collapsing distinct facts.
atom_policy.derived_facts: Required source components are included for multi-step questions; direct source-explicit quantities need not include every possible alternate derivation.
atom_policy.supporting_boundary: S006/S041 is an additional supporting/alternative-elimination overlap, although their target facts differ. Resolve conservatively for strict separation.
atom_policy.pilot_splits: pilot_dev and pilot_accept are grouped as pilot for cross-bank comparisons; no shared core atom was found between those two subsets.

source_counts.final_source_counts: Unknown until replacement drafts and fresh verification exist. Each replacement must be charged to its actual source page; do not assume a new URL is a new independent page.

source_cap_plan.proof: For a maximum of five items per page, twelve NASA items require at least seven removals/replacements, and nine IUPAC items require at least four. The proposed eleven meet this lower bound and clear the three NASA cross-bank pairs and IUPAC within-main numerical repeats.
source_cap_plan.S029_note: Dropping its atomic-weight clause is optional for overlap; its atomic-number atoms are already disjoint from the other four retained IUPAC questions. Any clause deletion changes difficulty and requires fresh verification.

recommendations.minimal_lower_work_option: Keep the same plan but drop C021 instead of replacing it: 84 main. This is the smallest additional deletion after source-cap changes and already excluded drops.
recommendations.fresh_verification: Every replacement and substantive revision must receive a new source-derived key, supporting passage, false-alternative check and renewed atom check before use. This audit accepts no as-yet-unseen draft.

tier_implications.caution: These are slot counts only, not verified difficulty ratings. A reduced 84/85 candidate plan explicitly abandons the original target of 30 usable main candidates per tier. Independently assess replacement difficulty rather than inheriting labels automatically.

allowed_same_source_examples.reason: Printing city, partner, vellum fraction, line-count name and language are different properties.
RNA base membership, backbone sugar and strandedness are distinct.
Transcontinental call date and city endpoints are distinct.
Micro multiplying factor and micro symbol are distinct properties; S032 does not test 10^-6.
Amino-acid codon count and UAG membership in stop codons are distinct.
Gold symbol, atomic number and atomic weight are distinct properties; S010/S028 are removed for other reasons.

caveats: Fact disjointness is stricter than stem uniqueness but does not guarantee statistical independence of questions sharing topics.
Source-page cap is assessed for main items only; no accidental cap is imposed on an institution or entire domain.
This fact audit does not certify distractor plausibility, tier balance, difficulty or final eligibility.
C024 source endpoint ambiguity remains until its replacement is independently verified.
C013 construction-start value is source-specific; the ledger reports other NPS dates but both precede pedestal construction.
Grand Canyon numeric ages are the cited approximate 2020 table values, not immutable ages.
